title: Supernatural smash-hit Paranormal Activity comes to Lowry this November as part of first ever tour
content:
There’s just under 2 weeks to go before the supernatural smash-hit Paranormal Activitycomes to the Lowry in Salford as part of its first ever UK & Ireland tour.

Praised for its inventive storytelling and terrifying atmosphere, Paranormal Activity is a must-see event for thrill-seekers and theatre lovers alike. Following its original run at Leeds Playhouse it has enjoyed two West End engagements at the Ambassadors Theatre as well as a North American tour, a Toronto engagement and a 20-week Broadway run.

A new story inspired by the worldwide horror phenomenon, Paranormal Activity, is directed by immersive theatre pioneer and Punchdrunk’s Founder and Artistic Director, Felix Barrett and written by playwright Levi Holloway, whose pulse-pounding theatrical thriller Grey House chilled Broadway audiences.

James and Lou move from Chicago to London to escape their past, but they soon discover that places aren’t haunted, people are…This thrilling West End hit is inspired by the iconic, hugely popular film series, Paranormal Activity, with a brand-new story live on stage. Now embarking on its first ever UK and Ireland tour after a sell-out, extended run in London, this chilling production promises to keep you on the edge of your seat from start to finish. Hold your nerve…

Paranormal Activity runs at the Lowry fromTuesday 17th to Saturday 21st November.

Age Guidance: 15+

Accessible Performances:

  • BSL | Wed 18 Nov 2026 at 7:30pm
  • Audio Described | Thu 19 Nov 2026 at 7:30pm. Touch Tour at 6:30pm
